name: Bibai (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Bibai city emblem in white, black and orange: a large white semicircle edged orange rising from the lower edge, bearing a black ring open at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Bibai, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 10 July 1970; the emblem dates from 2 September 1950.

features.role: Bibai city emblem — a large white semicircle edged orange rising from the lower edge, bearing a black ring open at the top
